about_the_game:
Would you describe your perfect day as doing something relaxing at home with the sound of the rain outside your window?
Then Hazel might be the playable character for you!

Hazel is a smol bean. Hazel is a chill charming moth person. Hazel is what'd happen if you turned "lo fi" into a person.
Play as this lovable character in their little big adventure outside their comfort zone. Introverted people can also go wild once in a while!

Grab a cup of tea, get cozy, and have a fun evening playing "Monster Roadtrip" as Hazel, the moth person.
